gui.module_shop_redpacket.cooldown_note: Sending has a cooldown; if you are too fast you will be asked to wait
gui.module_shop_redpacket.preview_idle: Fill in count and total to preview. Unclaimed money is refunded after %s.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.preview_lucky_: Lucky: random amounts (at least 1 each, up to about 2x the remaining average)
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_once_t: Each player can claim a red packet only once.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_expire_t: Whatever is unclaimed %s after sending counts as expired.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_refund_t: On expiry the remainder goes back to the sender's balance, with a chat notice.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_mail_t: If a balance is at its limit when claiming or refunding, the money is sent as a mail attachment instead; nothing is lost.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_lucky_t: Double-average method: each share is random between 1 and twice the remaining average, leaving at least 1 for everyone after; the last share takes what is left.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_even_t: Each share is total / count; any remainder adds 1 to the first shares.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_password_: Claimers must send the password in chat (up to %s characters, cannot start with /); the same password cannot be reused until that packet is finished.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_claim_t: Packets without a password are claimed with the [Claim] button in chat.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.rule_announce_: Announced in chat for everyone; click [Details] for the total and claim records.
gui.module_shop_redpacket.foot_hint: Password packets are claimed by sending the password in chat · one claim per player
gui.module_shop_redpacket.detail_foot_be: ★ Luckiest = highest amount once a lucky packet is finished
